flow: Regional beverage distributor, 180 SKUs across 4,200 retail points. Before Trackeys: 11% stockout rate, weekly lag, board-level issue. After: 6.4%, live signals, new growth runway.
Stockouts were 11% across a 4,200-outlet network. Distributor data arrived weekly at best. Replenishment decisions were made on 2-week-old data, and promo impact was always estimated in hindsight.

Rolled out Trackeys Distribution + SFA with offline van-sales capture. Distributor portal replaced the weekly Excel with daily secondary-sales logging. AI forecast layered promo lift as a continuous signal per SKU.
Within 90 days, stockouts dropped to 6.4%. Secondary sales rose 18%, attributed to better availability in fast-moving outlets. Promo-ROI analysis became weekly, not post-quarter.
